tasks.short: Coordinate curriculum opportunities with community leaders

steps.what: Confirm student training needs and curriculum requirements for the coordination discussion
inputs: approved curriculum requirements
actual student eligibility and support needs
outputs: confirmed training requirements and permitted information

steps.what: Find applicable government and community training opportunities and leader contacts
inputs: confirmed training requirements and permitted information
existing opportunity directory and contact records
outputs: candidate opportunities with source conditions and contacts

steps.what: Confer with government and community leaders about feasible student training arrangements
inputs: candidate opportunities with source conditions and contacts
confirmed training requirements and permitted information
leaders' actual availability and conditions
outputs: discussed training arrangements and unresolved conditions

steps.what: Record actual discussion outcomes, owners, dates and unresolved conditions
inputs: discussed training arrangements and unresolved conditions
outputs: confirmed outcome fields

steps.what: Prepare a confirmation message from the recorded arrangements and recipient
inputs: confirmed outcome fields
verified leader contact
outputs: complete confirmation message and recipient

steps.what: Review and approve the final arrangement confirmation and recipient
inputs: complete confirmation message and recipient
confirmed outcome fields
outputs: approved final confirmation and recipient

steps.what: Send the approved confirmation to the named community or government leader
inputs: approved final confirmation and recipient
outputs: sent arrangement confirmation

tasks.design: Filter existing {CRM} opportunity records against confirmed {LMS} requirements, then let the instructor confer with leaders. Prepare a native {EMAIL} confirmation from explicitly captured outcomes and send only its approved final version.
tasks.previous_blocker: An opportunity listing cannot confirm a leader's actual capacity or agreement.
tasks.enabler_now: Native structured filters and message templates can support lookup and confirmation preparation.
tasks.still_hard: Agree feasible arrangements that actually meet curriculum requirements.
tasks.human_edge: Build relationships and resolve practical constraints.

ambition.what: Support existing coordination without assuming more placements.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3; verify permitted student information and consultation needs

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: structured opportunity directories can be filtered and confirmed outcome fields can populate message templates.

assumptions: Boundary includes requirements, opportunity lookup, the instructor's own conference participation, outcome capture and confirmation. Leaders' independent participation is outside focal labour; it is unchanged and not counted as saved time.

Existing directory owner supplies opportunity ID, activity, eligibility, location, dates, contact and source/update date. s1 confirms curriculum requirement, student eligibility and permitted information; s3 obtains actual capacity, conditions and agreement; s4 counts capture of owner/date/action/condition fields. Missing fields or stale listings require manual investigation.

Native filters and templates come first. Central retains 60% of lookup and 50% of message preparation and removes a real distinct send, not a same-system save. Discussion and actual outcome recording remain unchanged.

s6 approves the complete final message and recipient after s5; edits void approval. Provisional B=100, R=85, gross=15; incremental focal directory/template upkeep=1; net=14. Shares are illustrative and independent of means priors.
unknowns: Directory currency and actual opportunity-search effort.
research_questions: Trace a coordination case and time stale-listing investigation and confirmation corrections.

already_counted.description: Final confirmation review retained at s6

incremental.description: Check directory filters and confirmation mappings for drift

approvals.approved_version: final arrangement confirmation and named leader recipient

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero where native lookup and confirmation already suffice; high allows four additional hours locating valid opportunities beyond central net 14.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Confirm course availability, entry criteria and the audience for student recruitment
inputs: current course schedule and actual available places
approved entry criteria
existing outreach permissions
outputs: confirmed recruitment facts and permitted audience

steps.what: Participate in publicity planning and community awareness discussions
inputs: confirmed recruitment facts and permitted audience
community outreach feedback
outputs: agreed publicity brief and channel choices

steps.what: Draft recruitment publicity and community awareness material for the chosen channels
inputs: agreed publicity brief and channel choices
confirmed recruitment facts and permitted audience
outputs: complete publicity copy with channel and audience settings

loop.input: approved course facts, audience and publicity brief
loop.output: proposed copy with source references and channel settings
loop.check: Instructor checks meaning, entry conditions, accessibility, omissions and absence of unsupported promises
loop.stop: One draft and one correction, then manual copy
loop.why_not_simpler: Existing channel templates come first; audience-specific explanation requires semantic wording beyond inserting course fields

steps.what: Review and approve the final publicity copy, channel and permitted audience
inputs: complete publicity copy with channel and audience settings
outputs: approved final publicity package

steps.what: Publish the approved recruitment material to its specified community channel
inputs: approved final publicity package
outputs: published recruitment material

steps.what: Discuss course suitability with prospective students during community recruitment
inputs: confirmed recruitment facts
prospective students' actual questions and circumstances
outputs: answered enquiries and agreed next actions

steps.what: Capture and confirm actual enquiries, permission status and agreed follow-up actions
inputs: answered enquiries and agreed next actions
prospect's actual contact permission
outputs: confirmed final enquiry record

steps.what: Save the confirmed enquiry record in the same recruitment system
inputs: confirmed final enquiry record
outputs: saved recruitment enquiry

tasks.design: Use confirmed {LMS} course facts and the agreed publicity brief in {DOCS} to assist recruitment copy. Publish its approved final version through {CMS}; keep community discussions and actual enquiry capture in {CRM} with the instructor.
tasks.previous_blocker: Publicity must explain real course conditions to different adult audiences.
tasks.enabler_now: Bounded wording assistance and native publishing controls can support the material workflow.
tasks.still_hard: Judge suitability and establish trust with prospective students.
tasks.human_edge: Understand barriers that a course description alone cannot resolve.

ambition.what: Support existing recruitment without claiming extra enrolments.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-4; confirm publication authority, contact permissions and consultation needs

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: models can propose source-based publicity wording and content systems can publish approved material.

assumptions: Scenario covers instructor participation in planning, material preparation, a real publication action and recruitment conversations. Course administrator supplies actual available places, schedule and entry criteria; s1 counts checking them. Instructor captures agreed audience/channel/message brief during s2; uncertain facts stop drafting.

s6 provides actual enquiry outcomes; s7 counts entering contact, permission, course interest and next action. No model infers permission and no new upstream capture is free. OTHER is the community recruitment venue.

Native templates and publication settings come first. Central retains 60% of drafting and removes only the real publication handling; planning and recruitment dialogue do not shrink. Same-system s8 save is approximately zero time and carries no saving.

Instructor is assumed to hold existing publication authority; if another approver is needed, retain and price its separate work before deployment. Final content and audience exist before s4 approval; edits void it. Provisional B=100, R=85, gross=15; incremental focal source/template upkeep=2; net=13. Shares are illustrative and independent of means priors.
unknowns: Actual publication authority and existing template coverage.
research_questions: Observe a recruitment campaign and test copy fidelity, actual audience controls and preparation effort.

already_counted.description: Final copy, channel and audience review in s4

incremental.description: Maintain approved publicity sources and inspect wording failures

approvals.approved_version: final publicity copy, channel and permitted audience

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero where templates already cover preparation and publication; high allows four extra hours of audience-specific correction beyond central net 13.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Advise students about internships and job placement

steps.what: Discuss the student's actual internship, employment and support needs
inputs: student's actual goals, qualifications, availability and constraints
existing course progress
outputs: discussed student placement needs and information permissions

steps.what: Capture and confirm actual placement requirements and information permissions
inputs: discussed student placement needs and information permissions
outputs: confirmed student placement requirements and permitted information

steps.what: Look up internships, prospective employers and placement services against the student's requirements
inputs: confirmed student placement requirements and permitted information
existing placement directory and current source listings
outputs: source-linked placement options and eligibility exceptions

steps.what: Advise the student on suitable options and explain trade-offs and next actions
inputs: source-linked placement options and eligibility exceptions
student's actual preferences and questions
outputs: discussed advice and student-agreed next actions

steps.what: Write the actual placement advice, chosen options and agreed next actions
inputs: discussed advice and student-agreed next actions
outputs: confirmed advice note and action fields

steps.what: Prepare the student's advice message with selected links and recorded next actions
inputs: confirmed advice note and action fields
selected source-linked placement options
verified student contact
outputs: complete advice message and student recipient

steps.what: Review and approve the final placement advice message and student recipient
inputs: complete advice message and student recipient
confirmed advice note and action fields
outputs: approved final advice message and recipient

steps.what: Send the approved placement advice to the specified student
inputs: approved final advice message and recipient
outputs: sent student placement advice

tasks.design: Use native {CRM} placement filters to support source checking, while the instructor advises the student and writes actual agreed actions in {DOCS}. Populate a native {EMAIL} template with selected links and captured actions, then approve and separately send its final version.
tasks.previous_blocker: Listings alone do not reveal which option fits a student's actual circumstances.
tasks.enabler_now: Structured filters and message templates can reduce supported lookup and repeated assembly.
tasks.still_hard: Judge fit and explain options without promising a placement.
tasks.human_edge: Help the student choose a practical next step.

ambition.what: Support current placement advice without automating suitability decisions.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3; verify student information access and consultation needs

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: placement directories support structured filtering and selected links can populate a message template.

assumptions: The instructor's s1 covers the live needs discussion; s1b separately captures actual requirements and permissions, and s4 writes actual advice and agreed actions. No conversation is reduced. No application to an employer or enrolment into a placement is included or implied.

Directory owner supplies opportunity/service ID, current status, qualification conditions, location, availability, source/update date and contact. Student supplies actual qualifications, goals and constraints, captured in s1. s2 reads source conditions and manually investigates stale or missing fields; numerical filters do not decide suitability.

Native filters and templates come first. Central retains 70% of lookup and 50% of message assembly, removing only a distinct real send. No same-system saving, existing automated matching runtime or speculative re-keying earns savings.

s6 follows the finished message and binds its actual recipient; changes void approval. Provisional B=100, R=87, gross=13; incremental focal directory/template upkeep=1; net=12. Shares are illustrative and independent of means priors.
unknowns: Directory coverage, listing currency and actual message-assembly work.
research_questions: Observe advice cases and time source verification, actual note capture and final message corrections.

already_counted.description: Final placement advice message review in s6

incremental.description: Review placement filter and message mapping failures

approvals.approved_version: final placement advice message and named student recipient

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero when native lookup and messages already cover the work; high allows four additional hours checking stale eligibility listings beyond central net 12.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional
